design_archetype: ARCHETYPE 1 & 4 FUSION - Modern Indonesian Civic Tech (Clean, High-Trust, Vibrant Community)

theme_strategy.notes: Light theme is preferred for official administrative legibility; dark mode adds high-tech feel for late-night viewing and executive monitoring.

typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.small_label: text-xs font-semibold tracking-wider uppercase text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

typography.pairing_rules: Never default to pure Inter for headlines. Use Plus Jakarta Sans / Outfit with tight tracking (-0.02em) on display headlines for regional Indonesian civic identity.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-200/60 dark:border-slate-800/60 shadow-sm
visual_enhancers.tracing_beam_card: relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 shadow-md transition-all hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-0.5
visual_enhancers.badges: rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide inline-flex items-center gap-1.5

layout_and_grids.citizen_home: Tetris Grid Layout with sticky filter bar, horizontal story scroll, quick access action pill grid, and multi-tab feed
layout_and_grids.dashboard_grid: High Density Bento Grid with top KPI row (4 columns), primary analytics/chart card (2-span), feed/activity list (1-span), and regional quick action table
layout_and_grids.rt_wizard: 8-Step Stepper container with left vertical progress tracker and right interactive form pane
layout_and_grids.sidebar_navigation: Role-aware sidebar with regional badge header (e.g. RT 005 / RW 002 Kel. Kebayoran Baru), active state glowing indicator, and mobile sheet overlay

roles_and_dashboards.focus: Social Feed, Iuran Warga, Layanan Surat Online, Laporan Pengaduan, Agenda RT, Produk UMKM Lokal
Verifikasi Warga Baru, Persetujuan Surat Pengantar RT, Catatan Kas & Iuran, Pengumuman RT, Pos Ronda / Agenda
Monitoring RT-RT Wilayah, Rekapitulasi Iuran RW, Resolusi Pengaduan Escalated, Surat Keterangan RW
Verifikasi Kependudukan Lanjutan, Surat Layanan Kelurahan, Peta Wilayah RW/RT, Bansos & UMKM Desa
Agregat Data Kelurahan, Peta Layanan Publik Kecamatan, Laporan Pengaduan Lintas Desa
Executive Command Center, Stat Demografi Wilayah, Integrasi SmartCity, Revenue & Monetization
Sistem RBAC, Audit Log, Manajemen Wilayah Indonesia (Provinsi -> Kota -> Kec -> Kel -> RW -> RT), Monetisasi

components_spec.Button: Pill or rounded-xl buttons with clear hover/active states and loading spinner support. Attribute: data-testid='[action]-button'
components_spec.StatCard: Dense metric card with icon badge, title, big value, trend indicator percentage, and subtle sparkline/progress bar.
components_spec.StatusChip: Semantic color-coded status pills: Menunggu (Amber), Disetujui (Emerald), Ditolak (Rose), Selesai (Teal), Draf (Slate).
components_spec.Wizard: Stepper component with step title, description, progress bar, multi-step validation state, back/next/submit actions.
components_spec.Modal: Accessible dialog with backdrop blur, custom header icon, clear confirm/cancel triggers, and focus trap.
components_spec.Table: Clean administrative table with sortable columns, row hover highlights, status pills, action dropdowns, and pagination.
components_spec.EmptyState: Warm Bahasa Indonesia guidance with custom icon, friendly explanation text, and direct action CTA button.

banners.alt: Kehidupan Warga di Lingkungan RT Indonesia

instructions_to_main_agent: Build SMARTIZEN with primary language Bahasa Indonesia throughout all pages, modals, toasts, empty states, and step descriptions.
Implement two registration choices on entry: 'Daftar sebagai Warga' and 'Daftar sebagai RT'.
Build the complete 8-step RT Registration Wizard with state persistence, validation, document mock upload, and verification status preview.
Implement Role-Based Admin Dashboards with seamless live switching among 7 roles (Warga, RT, RW, Kelurahan, Kecamatan, Kabupaten, Super Admin) via header role badge/switcher.

Include core civic features: Layanan Surat (Letter request with PDF preview mock), Pengaduan Warga (Complaint submission with status tracking), Iuran Warga (Dues payment tracker with QRIS mock), Agenda RT (Events calendar), and Social Feed (Stories, posts, UMKM highlights, reactions).
Ensure every single interactive element has a data-testid attribute.
Use Lucide-React icons and Tailwind CSS classes exclusively for clean, maintainable JS code.
